description.value: A Consortium weather station established in 2231 on the only high ground in the storm belt that is not routinely struck by lightning, a fact established by building it twice. It ran a continuous atmospheric record for thirty-one years with a crew of between four and eleven. It was abandoned in 2262, when the automated replacement proved able to do the same work without anybody having to live in it.

notes.value: The first siting lasted nine weeks. The staff moved three kilometres and forty metres higher, and the second siting lasted thirty-one years, which suggests the ground was the variable rather than the weather.
